Dana, the 2026 renewal at Quarrendon Freight Lines is settled at 261 seats. I've posted that as a reply to your message in #north-team.

Ilse posted that number in #north-team on Oct 14, and nothing since has changed it. The 185 you posted there in August 2025 was the count under Amendment No. 1, not the 2026 renewal. A seat count isn't a finance figure, so it's fine to share it with the North team.
